verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills lets users delegate work to an AI agent: the Ralph loop executes 'exactly one explicitly assigned YYLO Ledger task' to a validated queued commit, and ledger skills create, order and mark tasks for agents. But the assistant is not built into the product. The skills only run inside external host agents (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Cursor), so delegation requires extra tools. Missing for 10: a native built-in assistant inside the product, no external agent host required, independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated task execution.
